name: Hankou Shashin ~Shibarareta Shoujo-tachi no Mita Mono wa?~
original_name: 犯行写真　～縛られた少女たちの見たモノは？～
source:
Mystery goings on in this adventure game with a title translating as Crime Scene Photo and young ladies in danger. Plenty of real photographs to help as clues to solving the mystery. The detective must also review footage of them frolicking in their underwear and in the hot spring before a mystery man appears. 

[From [url=http://www.genkivideogames.com/hankou-shashin-imagineer-sega-saturn/t15008g]genkivideogames[/url]]
translation:
这款冒险游戏的标题是“犯罪现场照片”，游戏中充满了神秘色彩，年轻的女士们面临着危险。大量真实照片有助于作为解开谜团的线索。侦探还必须在神秘男子出现之前回顾他们穿着内衣和温泉嬉戏的镜头。

[来自[url=http://www.genkivideogames.com/hankou-shashin-imagineer-sega-saturn/t15008g]genkivideogames[/url]]
